transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How can I help you today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I feel like my mind is constantly spinning about work and I just can’t shut the worrying off, no matter what I’m doing. It’s gotten to the point where I just feel completely overwhelmed and don't know how to make it stop.
Do your worries mainly focus on specific situations, like public speaking or being in open spaces, or are they more general, like constant stress about work, health, or daily life?

It’s definitely more general and constant, rather than being tied to specific situations like public speaking. It feels like my brain has a running spreadsheet of "what-if" scenarios about work—like missing our quotas, losing accounts, or my boss thinking I can't handle the job—which then spills over into daily life, like worrying about how we'd pay our mortgage. It's just this non-stop, daily stress that I can't seem to shut off.
Over the past two weeks, have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy or felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

I wouldn't say I feel depressed or hopeless, but I've definitely lost the ability to enjoy the things I used to love. My constant anxiety about work has completely overshadowed my hobbies, so I've pulled back from my cycling club, community theatre, and even cooking because I just can't switch off and enjoy them anymore.
When you say you can't enjoy your hobbies anymore, is it mainly because you're too anxious and distracted by worries, or do you feel no interest or pleasure in them even when you try?

It's definitely because I'm too anxious and distracted, not because I've lost interest. I still really want to do those things, but when I'm on a bike ride or at a theatre rehearsal, my mind constantly drifts back to work and "what if" scenarios. It completely pulls me out of the moment and makes it impossible to actually relax and enjoy myself.
Have you experienced any days in the past two weeks where you felt little or no anxiety, and if so, were you able to enjoy activities during those times?

Honestly, I haven't had a single day in the past two weeks—or really even the past year—where I felt little or no anxiety. It is constantly running in the background all day, to the point where even trying to watch a show with my husband is interrupted by my mind jumping back to work "what-if" scenarios. There just hasn't been any break from it at all.
How long has this constant anxiety and worry been going on, and has it been present more days than not for at least six months?

It has been going on steadily for a little over a year now, starting a few months after I took over the larger regional sales team. It is definitely present almost every single day, so it has been well over the six-month mark.
